# B06 — Follow-up Editing & Read-only Deck Q&A (Dev Implementation)

**Status:** Detailed; begins after stable B05 published Deck + provenance contracts.  
**Outcome:** User sửa đúng slide/marked part, thêm slide hoặc presenter notes; hỏi về Deck mà không làm thay đổi Deck; mọi kết quả bám theo source và revision.  
**Specs:** UC-002, UC-009, UC-003; FR-027–031, FR-036, FR-066, FR-093, FR-107, FR-116, FR-125, FR-128–132, FR-136–140; NFR-012. Read full alternatives including UC-002 A19/A21 and UC-009 A2/A8.  
**Decisions:** [ADR-0003](../adr/0003-tools-permissions.md), [0004](../adr/0004-request-events-lifecycle.md), [0005](../adr/0005-deck-artifacts-revisions.md), [0007](../adr/0007-design-system-templates.md).

## 1. Scope and invariants

**In:** Follow-up intent routing, scope classification, safe partial edits, new slide insertion, presenter notes, design/theme changes, source-aware read-only Q&A, cross-slide disagreement checks, status and closing reports. **Out:** freeform direct DOM editor not specified by this UC, new Deck creation on edit, generation format conversion, automatically changing Design Systems due to updates (B07 controls catalog).

- Follow-up edits the **same logical Deck** and existing Slide IDs. Each modified slide has a **new immutable published revision**; no new Outline is drafted.
- No slide outside approved scope changes; marked-part edits preserve other parts of **that same slide** unless requested. Publication tool enforces scope, not just prompt.
- Read-only Q&A changes **no** slide, Outline or Brief. If message explicitly mixes Q&A and edit, follow UC-009 A2; if ambiguous between them, ask which (A8) and do nothing.
- Generation format stays locked. User-chosen color/font may override applicable theme role per spec; model-chosen colors/fonts must respect theme.

## 2. Ownership

| Owner | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `packages/presentation/deck/` | Stable slide identity, insert order, revision CAS, change scopes, presenter notes/metadata, theme snapshot mutation when explicitly requested |
| `packages/tools/presentation/` | Scoped read/publish/insert/notes tools authorized by Host; read-only tool subset for Q&A |
| `packages/host/api/` | Classify request as follow-up / Q&A / ambiguity, bind scope + allowed tools, persist request and report |
| `apps/local-web/src/opencode/` | Skill/prompt choice and per-request MCP tool grants; no own edit persistence |
| `packages/client/runtime/` + Local Web UI | Slide/marked-part selection, progress, report and source references |
| `packages/presentation/design/` | Existing theme roles/layouts for design changes and explicit switch to another Design System |

## 3. Dev tasks

### B06-IMP-01 — Follow-up intent and scope

- Resolve targets from user-mentioned slides, UI selection/marked parts and deck snapshot. If target or change unclear, **do not mutate**; ask one clarification with suggestions and end that request (UC-002 A1/A10). If slide reference is invalid, report mismatch/count and stop without editing (A5).
- Distinguish requested **edit** vs **read-only Q&A**; for mixed clear edit+question, execute edit then answer in closing message; if ambiguous which one, clarify before any tool invocation (UC-009 A2/A8).
- **Developer checks:** valid/invalid slide IDs, marked part mapping, ambiguous target/action, mixed intent, no unwanted publication.

### B06-IMP-02 — Scoped slide edits and insertion

- Bind allowed `slideIds` + specific marked regions to Request at Host admission. Tools must validate at dispatch and publication. For existing slides, read latest published revision and publish revised source with `expectedRevision`; do not overwrite file in place. New slides use distinct stable IDs and are inserted at requested position or end of deck; no second Deck or Outline.
- Stop/failure preserves finished revisions and last-good untouched slides; report changed/added count or unknown. Concurrency/stale revision must fail safely and leave published state unchanged.
- **Developer checks:** edit slide 2 of 5 and compare all out-of-scope revision hashes; edit a marked region without touching rest; two inserts at different orders; conflicting publish rejected; Stop mid-edit preserves last-good.

### B06-IMP-03 — Presenter notes and design changes

- Presenter-notes request changes notes of named slides only, not audience-visible content (UC-002 A9). Design-only change adjusts targeted layout/spacing/position/size without changing content/count/order (A8). A model-selected color/font must match theme; user-proposed out-of-theme value follows A19 question/answer behavior.
- Explicit change to another Design System updates whole Deck theme, keeps content and user-chosen part overrides, and rechecks slides (A21). Do **not** update Deck when the underlying custom DS was merely edited in settings (FR-106).
- **Developer checks:** notes-only visible HTML hash unchanged; style-only content preserved; theme switch preserves user overrides; no silent generation-format change.

### B06-IMP-04 — Deck Q&A with no write grants

- Route read-only questions to read-only Deck/provenance tools. Provide selected slide source/notes/provenance as inputs; never register publish/insert/mutate tools in this Request. Answer cites slide IDs and source kind; if source unknown, say unknown, not verified. Research only if user asks (UC-009 A6).
- Cross-slide conflict check identifies contradictory claims and their locations; only assert which is correct when user's material establishes it. Do not claim exhaustive contradiction detection.
- **Developer checks:** before/after snapshot hashes identical across Q&A; agent attempts publish and receives tool-denied; source lookup returns stored file/URL or unknown; contradiction fixture names pair, not invented certainty.

### B06-IMP-05 — Closing report + UI wiring

- UI marks selected parts and changed/new slides; closing message lists modified/added slides, what changed, untouched scope, assumptions/placeholders and source provenance for changed content (FR-029). Keep request activities visible across reload; unaffected slides and drafts unchanged.
- **Developer checks:** compare report against persisted publication receipts; out-of-scope unchanged assertion not just model text; same Deck reloads with edited revisions/notes; Q&A leaves Preview stable.

## 4. Developer integration checks

1. Published Deck → follow-up edit named slide → revised Preview → reopen (same Deck, non-target hashes unchanged).
2. Marked-part edit → only marked content changes; unclear scope → question, zero publications.
3. Add slide at position, add presenter notes, design-only change, explicit Design System switch.
4. Stop after some slide revisions, then continue; previous published revisions remain readable.
5. Q&A about provenance and contradictions → response with slide/source; zero write grants and zero Deck mutations.
6. Ask for another format → no conversion or edit; ambiguous question/edit → clarification only.

Use domain unit tests + Host/CLI integration fixtures; pinned CLI small smoke for both edit and Q&A; `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm build`. This is Dev verification, not independent behavior validation.

## 5. Dependencies / Dev Done / B08 handoff

B05 must expose finished slide source, revision/CAS, source metadata and immutable Deck identity. B07 custom catalog can extend explicit Design System selection later without changing B06 public contract. Keep **one owner** for publish/insert semantics; UI and read-only Q&A may develop in parallel against interfaces.

**Dev Done:** scoped edit/Q&A paths run end-to-end, revision and no-write guarantees have actual checks, clarification follows spec, reports reflect committed changes. Handoff stable editing and Q&A tool contracts + known limitations for B08 integration.
